takeaway: A strong fit for calendar sync: they schedule 400+ client sessions a month by hand.
summary: Hart & Miller Design is a 60-person design studio that books client workshops across three offices. Scheduling runs through shared inboxes and a spreadsheet, and their careers page lists an operations hire to fix it.

points.title: Calendar API
points.detail: Two-way sync would replace the spreadsheet they use to track workshop rooms and facilitators.

points.title: Scheduler
points.detail: Client-facing booking pages for workshops, with round-robin across facilitators.

points.title: Email API
points.detail: Lower priority: their client email already lives in a CRM.

say_this: You're booking 400 workshops a month across three offices by hand. What would it free up if clients could book a facilitator directly?
